{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
penguins = pd.read_csv('data/penguins.csv')

# Check the distribution of species across islands
cross_tab = pd.crosstab(penguins['species'], penguins['island'])
cross_tab

# Also check the overall mean flipper length by species
mean_flipper_by_species = penguins.groupby('species')['flipper_length_mm'].mean()
mean_flipper_by_species.sort_values(ascending=False)"}
